title: Smoked Apple Lavender Crumble
description: A sweet and savory dessert combining the flavors of smoked, lavender, and applesauce.

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour
ingredients.notes: gluten-free option: replace with almond flour

instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together flour, brown sugar, oats, and smoked sea salt.
Add dried lavender buds and stir to combine.
Add applesauce and mix until a crumbly mixture forms.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x9 inch baking dish.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until golden brown.
Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.
